content: Event-sourcing / projection drift: read models (here, the pixel office state) drift from the true event log without idempotent handlers (at-least-once delivery means duplicate events must not double-apply) and without tracking read-model lag (compare last-applied event ID/timestamp vs. event stream head). Recovery is to treat the projection as fully disposable/rebuildable: on detected staleness, reset and replay from the event log rather than patching state in place.
